prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.8 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.1 °C (59% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.65 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). Hydraulic valve exhibits slight transient lag while maintaining target pressure.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.32 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 786 W·min/l (105% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.9 % (47% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.8 bar (22% above healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
